Case ID: 1064
Case Type: Shipping Claim
Date: 2025-03-18
Handled By: Claims - Dana Brooks
Customer or Requestor: Rafael Soto
Title: High-value package damaged in transit

Issue Description
A customer submitted photos of a premium kitchen appliance arriving with visible exterior damage and a cracked display panel.

Steps Taken
- Validated the shipment tracking and confirmed the carton showed carrier damage notes at delivery.
- Compared customer photos with warehouse pack-out images to confirm the item left the facility intact.
- Reviewed claim eligibility against the carrier's damage reporting window and item value threshold.
- Prepared the carrier claim file with proof of value, photos, and order documentation.

Resolution
Approved an immediate replacement shipment for the customer and filed a reimbursement claim with the carrier for the damaged unit.

Follow-Up
Fulfillment flagged the packaging configuration for review because two similar damage cases were reported in the same week.

Reference Documents
- Lost Shipment Runbook v3
- Shipping Exception Runbook v2
